question: Is Vectara's 30-day trial (10,000 free credits, rerankers included) a standalone rerank or embedding API offer?
why: https://docs.vectara.com/docs/vectara-trial (read 2026-11-03) lists rerankers among the trial capabilities and 10,000 credits; the product is a managed retrieval platform with no separate embedding endpoint in the pages read, so it was not drafted.
